Nakula Brahmacārī became a śakty-āveśa incarnation of the Lord.»

Nakula Brahmacārī became a śakty-āveśa incarnation of the Lord.» The first half of the verse (*śaśirekhā tam āviśat*) the English translation reads as «a particle of moonlight» entering Nakula; others read it as the sakhī Śaśirekhā entering Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, of the verses before.
